module.name: Módulo 8
module.description: Big Data Integration, Management and Analysis – construction of a data pipeline that supports analysis and decision-making in environments with large data volumes. Module taught in English.

lessons.title: Learning the Dataset with Data Model Canvas
lessons.description: The five RM-ODP viewpoints as the basis for modelling the partner problem, followed by the folders and schemas of the partner Data Package and by group work in class: blocks 1 to 4 of the Data Model Canvas for the partner. Ends with the pre-class task for Lesson 2.

lessons.title: Advanced Exploratory Data Analysis
lessons.description: Flipped session on exploratory analysis. Before class, the groups run the first steps of a starter notebook. In class, they apply the eight steps to the partner data, record a data quality log, store a Parquet sample in the Data Lake and present what they achieved.

lessons.title: Architectural Tactics for Data Flow and Transformations
lessons.description: Flipped session. After studying the material and the self-studies at home, a thirty-minute exposition consolidates the medallion layers, quality checks, component diagrams and scalability tactics, and seventy minutes go to the graded Architecture Activity in class.

lessons.title: ETL: Object Storage to Data Warehouse
lessons.description: An ETL pipeline built in four rounds with a coding agent: the Bronze layer of a local MinIO in JSON, Parquet and CSV is extracted with DuckDB, cleaned, formatted, converted and enriched, and loaded into a DuckDB warehouse as the Silver layer in full and incremental modes.

lessons.title: Data Warehouses
lessons.description: The Silver layer of the Olist orders as a hybrid Data Warehouse, built live with a coding agent from the raw CSV files: an enriched table with the data_ingestao, data_linha and data_tag columns, written first to a long-lived lake read with DuckDB and then to ClickHouse with a one-year retention, reconciled, and modelled as a star schema with views and materialized views that compares the monthly sales of the North and the Southeast.

lessons.title: Data Cubes and Data Marts
lessons.description: A dimensional model built live in the browser over the prices that TCGplayer published for the Pokémon TCG sets of 2026: dimensions with hierarchies, a periodic snapshot, a cube with CUBE and a data mart, up to the cards that appreciated most. In the second hour, the same model over the partner data in ClickHouse.

lessons.title: DataApp Package with Layered Architecture
lessons.description: A Python package, built live with a coding agent, that automates everything Lesson 6 did by hand: extraction from TCGplayer, idempotent load, the gold layer with quality gates and a pipeline with retries and a run log, in three layers. In the second hour, the graded DataApp Packaging activity.

lessons.title: DAG Automation
lessons.description: An ETL pipeline structured as a Prefect DAG, with tasks and flows linked by explicit dependencies, and its scheduling, retries and monitoring.

lessons.title: Automated Testing
lessons.description: Automated tests derived from quality attributes with the ATAM: utility tree, six-part scenarios and test cases traced to pytest tests, built and run by each student alone as the in-class graded activity.

lessons.title: Metrics and Telemetry
lessons.description: Metrics, traces and structured logs of the DataApp linked from the alert to the log line, and a closed loop that compares the indicators with their objectives and acts within guardrails, escalating to a person when it cannot correct the DataApp.

lessons.title: DataApp Technical Infographics
lessons.description: Selection of chart types suited to the DataApp data and construction of interactive, accessible Streamlit dashboards with a consistent visual style.

lessons.title: Cloud Infrastructure Pricing
lessons.description: Cost estimation of the project infrastructure with the AWS Pricing Calculator, comparison of alternative configurations and optimisation through right-sizing and pricing models.

lessons.title: Data Security, Authorizations, and Access
lessons.description: The LGPD principles related to information security and data governance, and the access control, logging and data minimisation measures specified for the DataApp.
